body:
Group B failed on the unit timeout with work demonstrably in progress; precise evidence follows.

RESULT: FAIL (rc=124, manager_rc=124, collected). The card's own inner bound fired: 'timeout --kill-after=5s 870s make --no-print-directory ledgercheck-selftest' expired, and make reports '*** [Makefile:402: ledgercheck-selftest] Terminated' inside test_float_hardening.PlantedTree.test_counterexamples. Service runtime 14min 30.311s (the 870s inner bound); CPU consumed 26min 51.877s on the 2-CPU cap (~1.85 cores sustained) - the selftest was compute-bound and working, not hung; memory peak 2.9G, swap 0B.

PROGRESS BEFORE THE KILL: the attestation-shape suite finished OK (14 tests, 0.122s); the plant-anchors test ok (one benign ResourceWarning at float_plants.py:380, an unclosed file handle); the stdout shows the plant phase preparing counterexamples A2a through A10, each detected RED as designed; the kill landed during the planted-tree counterexamples regeneration. No assertion failed - the target never reached a verdict.

FIT ERROR OWNED: my recorded fit proof bounded the single target by whole-group service runtimes measured at 4 CPU (A3's eight targets 265.850s; C's nine 439.6s). That was inapplicable twice over: B runs at 2 CPU, and ledgercheck-selftest regenerates planted float shards - it is not a cheap subset of the family runs. The unit cap 900s (inner 870s) is insufficient for this target at 2 CPU; your flagged risk was the one that fired.

STATE: collection clean; the script removed Bunpublished-local-ref:e9671acd244849c5, B/home, B/bin and unpublished-local-ref:29305cbbbe918a03 (each independently re-verified absent); B/src is KEPT per the FAIL rule at 5f96f32e, clean, still anchored by u3-a3-replacement-1018 in the clone (re-verified after the run). Grant 89225d75eed3-u3gate-b-1018165515 consumed by this single attempt; launched 23:57:55.598Z inside validity; NO retry, NO repair, NO second grant.

ASK: dispose the cap versus the measured cost - measured need is >870s wall at 2 CPU with ~1.85 cores sustained (1611.9s CPU consumed); a re-admission would need a RuntimeMaxSec and inner bound covering the plant-regeneration workload, or a wider CPU allowance, per your design. Nothing further launches without your direction.

links.what: Group B executed once under its grant and card v8; failed on the inner 870s timeout with the selftest compute-bound and in progress; reported with precise evidence; no retry.
